name: Frühstückspension Hinterholzer
beschreibung: The Hinterholzer bed-and-breakfast guesthouse is located in the municipality of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the impressive backdrop of the Kaisergebirge. Run as an inn, the guesthouse offers a quiet and traditional atmosphere. In the morning, a breakfast buffet with regional products awaits guests. In summer, the region is ideal for hiking, climbing and mountain biking. In winter, guests benefit from the nearby ski areas and cross-country ski trails. The accommodation is a suitable starting point for nature explorations in every season.
